skills.name: migraciones-alembic

skills.name: propuesta-comercial

skills.name: notas-de-version
skills.description: Escribir notas de versión y changelogs a partir de los commits y las tareas cerradas, agrupadas por novedades, mejoras y correcciones.

skills.name: atencion-cliente
skills.description: Responder correos e incidencias de clientes con tono cercano: entender el problema, pedir los datos que falten y proponer una solución.

skills.name: seguridad-owasp
skills.description: Revisar una aplicación web en busca de vulnerabilidades OWASP: inyección SQL, XSS, autenticación rota, control de acceso y secretos en el código.

skills.name: pruebas-e2e-playwright
skills.description: Escribir y depurar pruebas de extremo a extremo con Playwright: selectores estables, esperas, fixtures y capturas al fallar.

skills.name: facturas-pdf

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Review the changes of a branch against main: the repository's coding standards and what the task asked for. Use when asked to review a branch or a pull request.

skills.name: debugging
skills.description: Diagnose hard bugs and performance regressions: reproduce, narrow down with logs and bisection, find the root cause before fixing.

skills.name: tdd
skills.description: Test-driven development: write the failing test first, then the code, red-green-refactor, when building features or fixing bugs.

skills.name: react-performance
skills.description: Make React and Next.js pages faster: memoization, avoiding re-renders, code splitting, server components and image optimization.

skills.name: docker-compose
skills.description: Write and fix Dockerfiles and docker-compose files: multi-stage builds, volumes, networks and health checks for local development.

skills.name: cloud-deploy
skills.description: Deploy an already prepared application to the cloud provider with its CLI, check the release and roll back if it fails.

skills.name: cloud-storage
skills.description: Store and serve user uploads in cloud object storage buckets: signed URLs, access policies and lifecycle rules.

skills.name: cloud-logs
skills.description: Query production logs and metrics in the cloud provider's log analytics with its query language to find failing requests.

skills.name: video-create

skills.name: video-captions
skills.description: Transcribe the audio of a video and add animated captions synchronized with the speech.

skills.name: video-render

skills.name: browser-automation
skills.description: Automate a web browser: open pages, fill in forms, click buttons, download files and take screenshots of websites.

skills.name: social-posts
skills.description: Write and publish posts on social networks like X and LinkedIn to announce releases.
